report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency issues, but current telemetry shows healthy services: error_rate 0.001, p95 78ms, zero db_pool_waiters and dependency_timeouts across gateway, order, and payment. Order shows high retained memory (300MB, retained_after_gc) but no memory-retention history and no latency/error impact, so a leak cannot be claimed. No evidence supports any taxonomy candidate; hand off for missing evidence.
missing_evidence: Current telemetry showing elevated checkout error rate or latency (all services show error_rate 0.001, p95 78ms)
Evidence of db pool exhaustion: db_pool_waiters and dependency_timeouts are 0 across services
Evidence of downstream latency or redis timeout in gateway/order/payment dependency calls
Chronological memory-retention series for order to substantiate or rule out memory-leak
Deployment records or config changes aligned to the alert window
